composition_or_description: Soy-oil-derived natural-oil polyol made from hydroxymethylated soybean fatty acid methyl esters and a PEG triol initiator.
Mixed-feed ethylene oxide/propylene oxide tetrol initiated with 3,3'-diamino-N-methyl-dipropylamine; contains 12% ethylene oxide.
notes: Equivalent weight is source-reported; OH number is not back-calculated here.
Source uses VORANOL 3008 wording; later example text says Voranol CP 3008. Stored as one source-level material identity with the naming difference retained in notes.
